scope: WWS-1 outer hull round ports, L2 panoramic band and crown's AOI interspace; no new opening or hull geometry
source: WWS-1 R2, crown equivalent 3000 kg/45.037125 m2

bulk.nanofibre_requirement: BNNT-H <1% by mass; optically index-matched, long-term dispersion UNPROVEN
notes: 0.005 BNNT-H mass fraction and 0.01 10B-carborane are unqualified modeling assumptions, not demonstrated transparent recipe
10B captures some thermal neutrons but produces capture reaction secondaries; ZERO radiation-dose benefit credited
Effective density 1000 kg/m3 is a speculative fit constraint; real alkane organogels are often less dense, so available cavity thickness may force a redesign

crown_fit.cavity_fit: Average-column only, local 59.73mm minimum means exact conformal cavity fill/thermal compliance OPEN. Do not assert local clearance.
crown_fit.unspent_class: Already uncommitted; NO new reserve credit, NO physical addition

shield_areal.physical_ray_mission_qualification: PENDING actual composition-and-geometry particle transport; not certified by column sum

operating_rule.open: quiet sun only; radiation forecast and monitoring available, heat pump operational, low dust
operating_rule.SPE_min_ray_class: LOOM local ray design criterion; NOT asserted to be NASA's general SPE prescription

research.literature_claim: NASA Norman et al (2017) observed modeled aluminium minimum near 20-30 g/cm2 and hydrogen-rich polyethylene dose-equivalent curve flattening at higher areal depth; no universal 20 g/cm2 threshold or OG-3 dose computed
